title: An Office Policy
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: An Office Policy. Locally generated synthetic English speech.

transcript.text: Employees may work from home up to two days a week, provided their manager approves the arrangement in advance. The policy does not apply to days when face-to-face training is scheduled. Staff should not assume that an informal conversation counts as approval; the request must be recorded in the online system.

questions.prompt: What is the maximum regular remote-work allowance?
questions.explanation: The policy permits up to two days weekly.

questions.prompt: When does the policy not apply?
options: When managers are in the office
A printed letter from a client
questions.explanation: Informal discussion is not sufficient; online recording is required.
